title: Optical Module NPI Milestone Timeline
goal: Move the next-generation optical module from concept review to controlled customer pilot.

milestones.name: Concept Review
milestones.output: Confirm customer requirements, target cost, and performance envelope

milestones.name: Architecture Freeze
milestones.output: Lock optical engine, driver architecture, and package concept

milestones.name: EVT Build
milestones.output: Build engineering samples and close first assembly issues

milestones.name: EVT Gate
milestones.output: Review yield, optical margin, firmware stability, and open risks

milestones.name: DVT Start
milestones.output: Start reliability, thermal, signal-integrity, and interoperability testing

milestones.name: Pilot Approval
milestones.output: Approve pilot quantity, containment plan, and customer sample release

milestones.name: Customer Pilot
milestones.output: Ship pilot units and monitor field link stability

milestones.name: Release Decision
milestones.output: Decide controlled launch based on pilot yield and reliability evidence

notes: Gate decisions should be based on yield, reliability, and customer-readiness evidence.
Customer pilot release requires a containment plan for open risks.
